RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel and qualification differences can indicate subtle affinity bias, but panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. Municipal executive roles often emphasize interview performance, council relationships, or public engagement over technical degrees.

Raising gender bias now will likely trigger a defensive legal stance rather than constructive feedback. Instead:
1. Check if the municipality violated internal diversity policies regarding interview panels.
2. Follow up politely on your feedback request, or obtain the scoring rubrics and interview notes through a public records request.
3. Consult an employment attorney before citing gender or panel demographics in any formal challenge.
